digest.component_or_area: Ticket store completion verification and concurrent read/write isolation
propositions: Full ticket-store materialization currently requires 135-235 seconds for 5,500 directories and 132,000 files; a pinned Git revision read via lazy object fetching completes scoped ticket extraction in ~29 ms, approximately 4,600-8,000× faster
Pinned reads at Git commit OID A remain byte-identical after live mutations advance the store to descendant OID B, proving stable isolated reads during concurrent mutations

Scoped extraction and reduction produce identical canonical hashes to full-store live state, but isolated-ticket alias resolution requires pinned namespace/resolver context—a design gotcha not universally applicable

Validation must track typed exact-ticket, negative-existence, direct-child membership, predicate, link, and global-context dependencies; mutations to any dependency category must trigger re-validation and potential conflict/retry

Current completion implementation mixes pinned code with live checkout inputs, permits parallel cache-writer collisions on shared temp paths, and lacks atomic rollback safety for PASS/STATUS/SIGNATURE sidecar writes under lock
